details:
Project Description – The Lost Legacy (Space Trace)

The Lost Legacy is an interactive educational project designed to explore and preserve the history of humanity’s forgotten space hardware. Through our website, Space Trace, users can explore different planets using an interactive map inspired by Google Earth and discover spacecraft, rovers, landers, and other space equipment that were lost, abandoned, or no longer active during space exploration missions.

The website allows users to select a planet and explore its surface to discover historical space missions and their forgotten equipment. Each discovery provides information about the hardware, its mission, its purpose, and its historical significance.

Our project aims to make space history more accessible, engaging, and interactive. It helps users understand the challenges of space exploration, learn about previous missions, and recognize the importance of preserving scientific and technological achievements. Its intended impact is to increase public awareness of space exploration history and inspire curiosity about science, astronomy, and future missions.

We developed the project using web development technologies and an interactive mapping approach. Our tools included HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and mapping and visualization resources, along with space mission information from NASA and other reliable sources. The project was designed as a website to make it accessible across different devices.

The creative aspect of our project is the combination of storytelling, space exploration, and interactive technology. We also developed a fictional astronaut character named Oliver, who guides users through the journey and connects the historical story with the actual educational content of the website.

During development, our team considered scientific accuracy, ease of use, accessibility, educational value, visual design, and the reliability of information. We also focused on making complex space history understandable and interesting for users with different levels of scientific knowledge.

Ultimately, The Lost Legacy transforms forgotten space hardware into an interactive journey through humanity’s achievements beyond Earth.
